intro: Financial services and government sectors were the primary targets in a wave of phishing attacks tracked by ZCyberNews, with 54 incidents recorded between April 8 and May 1, 2026. The threat actors Silver Fox, AccountDumpling, and Bluekit were observed exploiting vulnerabilities including CVE-2023-22515, CVE-2023-34048, CVE-2023-46805, CVE-2023-4966, and CVE-2024-21893. The campaigns affected regions globally, with notable impact in Latin America, Canada, the Caribbean, and the United States. The severity mix comprised 46 high-severity and 8 medium-severity incidents.
